# AI Chatbot

> A custom chat agent for a local service business that answers repeat customer questions right away on its website, built around the business’s own services, prices, and rules. $149 setup + $49/month.

AI Chatbot is a product by Northbeam Builds, a small studio in Austin, TX that builds websites and AI tools for local service businesses. Company site: https://northbeambuilds.com

## What it is

AI Chatbot — for shop owners who get the same questions in messages all day: it’s a chat agent built around your business that answers repeat questions right away on your website, so no visitor’s question sits unanswered while you’re on a job.

## Who it is for

For: Your shop answers the same questions over and over.; The same questions land on your website all day, and they pile up while you work.; You want chat that can point a customer to your booking page or take their details.
Not for: You only need simple questions answered on your website — the cheaper tool below does that.; You want a voice answering phone calls — that’s the AI Phone Receptionist.

## Price

$149 one-time setup + $49/month. First month total: $198. Month-to-month — cancel anytime, no long contract. Live by the date we agree, or your setup fee comes back in full — guaranteed.
Buy online (Stripe checkout): https://buy.stripe.com/dRm8wP2cA05e40a3J4gYU03

## How it works

1. We sit down with your real questions — the ones customers ask every day — and how you want each one answered.
2. We build the conversations around your services, prices, and rules. You read and approve the answers before it goes live.
3. It answers on your website right away — and hands real jobs to you, with the whole conversation attached.

## What is included

- Your custom question-and-answer set, built with you.
- Chat set up on your website.
- Plain-language answers you approve first.
- Hand-off of real jobs to you, with the conversation attached.
- Updates to answers when your prices or services change.
- Live by the date we agree, or your setup fee comes back in full — guaranteed.

## Questions and answers

- Q: How is this different from the $49 website agent?
  A: That one answers from your website pages, on your site only. This one is built around your business: more questions, in your wording, and it can point a customer to your booking page or take their details.
- Q: What happens when it can’t answer?
  A: It doesn’t guess. It takes the customer’s details and hands the conversation to you, with everything they already said attached.
- Q: Will it sound like a robot?
  A: It answers in plain words, using the answers you approved. You read every answer before it ever goes live.
- Q: Can I cancel?
  A: Yes. Month-to-month. Cancel anytime and you owe nothing further.
